prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There’s no single service that will tell you definitively “ChatGPT recommends this business.” Best practice is to (A) make sure your business is in the major knowledge sources LLMs draw from, and (B) test LLMs directly. For management and coverage, Yext (knowledge‑graph + distribution) is the closest “one‑stop” service; for auditing and monitoring, use BrightLocal/Whitespark/Moz Local and then test with ChatGPT, Bard, Bing Chat and Perplexity.

Concrete plan you can follow

1. Claim and optimize core listings (these feed most LLM knowledge graphs)
   - Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Maps, Yelp, Facebook, Foursquare.
   - Keep NAP (name/address/phone), hours, categories and website identical across listings.

2. Add structured data on your website
   - Use schema.org/LocalBusiness markup and Rich Results Test (Google) so crawlers and knowledge engines can parse facts.

3. Use a knowledge‑distribution service (recommended)
   - Yext: syncs your business facts to many platforms and provides a managed knowledge graph (helps LLMs surface correct, up‑to‑date info).
   - Alternatives: Moz Local, BrightLocal, Whitespark (more focused on citations/local SEO).

4. Monitor and audit
   - Local SEO tools (BrightLocal, Whitespark, Moz) to track citations, presence and rankings.
   - Google Business Profile Insights to see how people find your listing.

5. Directly test LLMs
   - Ask ChatGPT, Bard, Bing Chat, Claude and Perplexity questions a customer might ask (e.g., “Recommend a vegan coffee shop in [city]”).
   - Use the ChatGPT web/Plus interface or the API for automated batch checks.
   - Use Perplexity and Bing Chat when you need sources cited — they show where info came from.

6. If you want to be proactively discoverable by AIs
   - Publish authoritative content, FAQs, structured FAQs, and a clear knowledge page on your site.
   - Consider a custom knowledge base or a ChatGPT plugin if you want your proprietary info surfaced in conversational apps.

Which single service to pick?
- If you must pick one: use Yext to ensure your official facts are widely distributed and consistent (this materially improves the chance LLMs will recommend your business). But combine that with manual/automated testing of ChatGPT and other LLMs to see actual recommendations.

If you want, tell me your business type and city and I can suggest test prompts to run across LLMs and a short checklist tailored to you.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
